The size (in degrees, $d$) of each interior angle of a regular polygon with $n$ sides is given by the formula:

$$d=\dfrac{90(2n-4)}{n}$$

Use this formula to show that the size of each interior angle in a regular hexagon is $120^\circ$.

A stone is thrown straight up, and the height in metres after $t$ seconds is given by the formula

$$h = 9.8t - 4.9t^2 .$$

What is the stone's height when $t = 1$?

solutions.latex:
Substitute $t = 1$.
$$\begin{aligned} h &= 9.8(1) - 4.9(1)^2 \\ &= 4.9 \text{ m} \end{aligned}$$
Hence the answer is B.
